Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Ahmedabad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Ahmedabad Vice President (Research) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Vice President (Research) post is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Vice President (Research) position?
faq.answer: Candidates need a PhD / MBA / CA/ CFA / CAIA / Masters (or higher degree) in Economics or Public Policy from a reputed institution with experience in sectoral policies and knowledge of precious metals industry regulations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Vice President (Research) post is between 40 to 55 years, with relaxation available for deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Vice President (Research) post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Pay Level 13A under the pay matrix of the 7th Central Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Vice President (Research) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Vice President (Research) position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIM Ahmedabad located?
faq.answer: IIM Ahmedabad is located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the apply online link in the "Important Links" section of this article.
